result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues, mainly related to content being cut off at the screen edge and category tabs being truncated.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section's third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with the name and delivery fee truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling cards are properly clipped/faded at the edge or add a visual indicator (like a partial card fade) to show more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional category partially visible and cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or scroll indicator to signal that more categories are available via horizontal scroll.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text rendering error rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis (...) when text is truncated to indicate more content exists.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotion card image is cut off at the bottom of the screen, ending abruptly mid-image.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scrollable content height or add proper spacing/padding to avoid abrupt cutoffs at the viewport boundary.
